claims.label: Bradley Hansell Serves as Under Secretary of War for Intelligence and Security
claims.claim: Per the Department of War website the host cites, Bradley Hansell exercises authority, direction, and control over all intelligence and security organizations in the Department of War on behalf of the Secretary of War.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the Department of War website listing for Bradley Hansell; cross-check Senate confirmation record and July 25, 2025 swearing-in.

claims.label: Bradley Hansell Was Sworn In on July 25, 2025
claims.claim: Per host, Hansell was nominated by Trump and confirmed by the Senate, then sworn in on July 25, 2025.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify Senate roll-call vote and swearing-in date via official Senate records.

claims.label: Bradley Hansell Served in Navy and Army Special Forces Airborne Division
claims.claim: Per host, after serving in the Navy and Army Special Forces Airborne Division, Hansell went to work for the Boston Consulting Group.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify service record via official DoD / Army Special Forces sources.

claims.label: Bradley Hansell Served as Special Assistant to President Trump for National Security Affairs
claims.claim: Per host, Hansell was picked to work under Trump's first administration as a member of the National Security Council as Special Assistant to President Donald J. Trump for National Security Affairs.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify NSC roster for Trump's first term.

claims.label: Bradley Hansell Worked at the Boston Consulting Group
claims.claim: Per host, Hansell worked at the Boston Consulting Group both after his military service and after Trump's first term (returning as a principal of the firm).
claims.investigative_direction: Verify BCG alumni records and LinkedIn-style biographies.

claims.label: Project Aurora launched in late 2024 as a pro bono feasibility study for the Gaza Humanitarian Foundation
claims.claim: Per the Financial Times reporting summarized on a website read by the host, Project Aurora was launched in late 2024 and was originally framed as a pro bono feasibility study for the Geneva-registered Gaza Humanitarian Foundation.
claims.investigative_direction: Retrieve original Financial Times article and Project Aurora documents.

claims.label: Project Aurora evolved into a $4M consulting contract
claims.claim: Per the website read by the host, Project Aurora evolved over 7 months into a fully-built consulting contract reportedly worth $4 million.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm $4M figure against leaked internal documents referenced by Financial Times.
claims.transcript_snippet: Over 7 months, the project evolved into a fully build consulting contract reportedly worth $4 million.

claims.label: Project Aurora proposed a $9,000-per-person voluntary departure for ~500,000 Palestinians
claims.claim: Per host reading, one Project Aurora model proposed $9,000 in cash per person aimed at relocating around 500,000 Palestinians outside the Gaza Strip.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify model parameters against FT-published leaked documents.

claims.label: Project Aurora alternative model proposed $5,000 plus four years subsidized housing and one year food assistance
claims.claim: Per host reading, a second Project Aurora model lowered direct payments to $5,000 and added four years of subsidized housing and one year of food assistance.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify model parameters against FT-published leaked documents.

claims.label: Project Aurora total cost estimates ranged from $2.5 billion to $5 billion
claims.claim: Per host reading, total Project Aurora costs ranged from $2.5 to $5 billion.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify cost ranges against FT-published leaked documents.

claims.label: BCG dismissed two senior partners in July 2025 after the Financial Times story
claims.claim: Per host reading, BCG dismissed two partners and launched an external audit in July 2025 after the Financial Times story.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm dismissals and audit via BCG press releases or FT follow-up reporting.

claims.label: Christoph Schweizer (BCG CEO) described Project Aurora as "reputationally very damaging"
claims.claim: Per host reading, BCG CEO Christoph Schweizer described the Project Aurora episode as "reputationally very damaging."
claims.investigative_direction: Locate Schweizer's original statement in Financial Times coverage.

claims.label: Johnnie Moore was appointed executive chairman of the Gaza Humanitarian Foundation
claims.claim: Per Times of Israel article referenced by host, Johnnie Moore was appointed executive chairman of the Gaza Humanitarian Foundation after Jake Wood's resignation and BCG's withdrawal.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify appointment date and tenure length (host states Moore "eventually abandoned the project November").

claims.label: Jake Wood resigned as CEO of the Gaza Humanitarian Foundation prior to BCG's withdrawal
claims.claim: Per Times of Israel article referenced by host, GHF's previous CEO Jake Wood quit prior to BCG's withdrawal from the project.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify Jake Wood's resignation date and public statement.

claims.label: BCG developed logistics, organizational structure, and security contractor pricing for the Gaza Humanitarian Foundation
claims.claim: Per host, BCG helped develop the logistics, the organizational structure, and the pricing for paying and equipping private security contractors to operate the food distribution hubs in Gaza for the GHF.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify BCG-GHF operational scope via FT reporting or leaked BCG documents.

claims.label: Palantir announced a $10 billion military software deal including stationing at Fort Huachuca
claims.claim: Per host-cited article, Palantir announced a $10 billion enterprise software deal with the military and will be stationed at Fort Huachuca.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify primary outlet (host references "elsewhere"); confirm Fort Huachuca stationing date.

claims.label: Mitt Romney was the driver in a June 16, 1968 France car crash that killed Leola Anderson
claims.claim: Per NYT article, on June 16, 1968, Mitt Romney was driving a car in southern France that was hit head-on; H. Duane Anderson's wife Leola was killed.
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-check NYT article with contemporaneous French press; verify date.

claims.label: Albert Marie, a 46-year-old Catholic priest, was the driver of the other vehicle in the 1968 crash
claims.claim: Per NYT article, the driver of the car that struck Romney's was a 46-year-old man, Albert Marie, a Catholic priest.
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-check name and role against French archival records; note host's claim that some Mormons believe the priest may have been inebriated but "that assertion could not be confirmed."

claims.label: Mitt Romney Operated a "Pierre Delecto" Burner X/Twitter Account
claims.claim: Per viewer comments read on-air and host concurrence, Mitt Romney operated a burner X account under the French name Pierre Delecto.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the @PierreDeleto account or its archived screenshots; cross-reference with prior reporting on Romney's French-language social media activity.

claims.label: Erika Kirk deleted 126 Instagram posts on June 19, 2025
claims.claim: Per host's displayed working timeline, on June 19 – the second day Charlie Kirk was at the White House arguing against Iran involvement – Erika Kirk purged her Instagram, deleting 126 posts.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain archived screenshots of Erika Kirk's Instagram account as of June 18–19, 2025.

claims.label: Turning Point USA submitted a request for Charlie Kirk to speak at UVU on July 18, 2025
claims.claim: Per local news in Utah cited by host, Turning Point USA submitted on July 18, 2025 for Charlie Kirk to do his event at Utah Valley; host states she has been unable to independently confirm.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the actual UVU event submission paperwork; identify the requesting student organization.

claims.label: Mitt Romney and Benjamin Netanyahu both worked at the Boston Consulting Group
claims.claim: Per host (recapping prior episodes) and per the on-screen connection graphic, Mitt Romney and Benjamin Netanyahu both worked at the Boston Consulting Group.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify BCG employment for both Romney and Netanyahu via BCG alumni directories or independent reporting.

claims.label: Bain Capital was founded by Mitt Romney with Robert Maxwell as a seed investor
claims.claim: Per host (recapping prior episodes), Mitt Romney founded Bain Capital with Israeli spy Robert Maxwell (father of Ghislaine Maxwell, host spelling) as one of his seed investors.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify Bain Capital founding investors list; cross-check Robert Maxwell investment history.

claims.label: Orbis (Washington-area security contractor) initially engaged BCG on Project Aurora
claims.claim: Per the displayed on-screen graphic and host description, Orbis – a Washington-area security contractor – initially engaged BCG to help with a feasibility study for a new aid project.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify Orbis involvement via FT reporting or leaked BCG documents.

claims.label: Orbis Prepared the Project Aurora Study on Behalf of the Tachlith Institute (Israeli Think Tank)
claims.claim: Per the displayed on-screen graphic and host description, Orbis was prepping the study on behalf of the Tacit/Tachlith Institute, an Israeli think tank.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the existence and nature of the Tacit/Tachlith Institute; flag uncertain spelling.

claims.label: BCG was selected for Project Aurora due to its long-standing relationship with Phil Reilly, ex-CIA operative at Orbis
claims.claim: Per the displayed on-screen graphic and host description, BCG was chosen as Project Aurora consultant because of its long-standing relationship with Phil Reilly, an ex-CIA operative who worked for Orbis.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify Phil Reilly's CIA and Orbis employment; cross-check BCG-Riley relationship in FT reporting.

claims.label: Host Says Channel Reached Six Million Subscribers With No Ad Spend or Outside Funding
claims.claim: The host says her channel reached six million subscribers with zero dollars spent on advertising, no outside investors and no secret funding from foreign countries.
claims.investigative_direction: Check the channel's public subscriber count and any disclosed advertising or financing; the funding denial can only be tested against the host's financial records.
claims.transcript_snippet: Without a single dollar spent on advertising, zero dollars. That's actually just an incredible feat. No outside investors, no secret funding from foreign countries

claims.label: Host Says She Has Identified the Official Aboard the Plane That Left Fort Huachuca September 9
claims.claim: The host says her team has identified a high ranking US government official in this administration who was aboard the plane that left Fort Huachuca on the morning of September 9, and that this will not put conspiracy theories about Charlie Kirk's death to bed.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the SAM702 flight manifest and passenger list for September 8-9, 2025 (FOIA, Air Mobility Command, Fort Huachuca flight operations).
claims.transcript_snippet: We have identified our passenger, our high ranking US government official uh part of this administration that was aboard the plane which left Fort Huachuca on the morning of September 9th.

claims.investigative_direction: Ask Charlie Kirk Show staff or TPUSA for the booking request; look for contemporaneous reporting of Netanyahu's team approaching the Kirk show.
claims.transcript_snippet: He wanted to come on Charlie Kirk's show and Charlie refused him.

claims.transcript_snippet: He did the Nelk Boys that was released on July 21st. He did uh Trigonometry that was released on August 20th. He also did the Patrick Bet David show that was recorded and then released on August 26th.

claims.label: Host Says Netanyahu Is on an American Public Relations Tour in the Run-Up to the Assassination

claims.investigative_direction: Compile all Netanyahu US media appearances in 2025 and any Israeli government statements explaining the outreach.
claims.transcript_snippet: Uh suddenly though he is BB Netanyahu is overcome with the need to hit that podcast circuit. He's effectively on what can be described an American public relations tour in the run-up to Charlie's assassination?

claims.investigative_direction: Check the date and location of the Lex Fridman interview with Netanyahu and list his US podcast appearances 2023 to 2025.

claims.label: Host Says Netanyahu's Last American Media Tour Was 2022 to Promote His Book
claims.claim: The host says Netanyahu's last comparable American press tour was in 2022, when he was not the sitting prime minister and was promoting his book, whereas in 2025 he had no product to sell.
claims.investigative_direction: Check Netanyahu's 2022 book-tour appearances (his memoir) and confirm none were while in office.

claims.label: Host Says Charlie Declined Netanyahu Because of a Change of Heart on Israel and the Hamptons Intervention
claims.claim: The host says the answer to why Charlie Kirk refused to host Netanyahu is that Charlie had a change of heart about Israel, and that the Hamptons intervention the weekend of August 5 furthered his resentment of their strong-arming influence.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain statements from Kirk's circle, Hamptons attendees or messages showing Kirk's stated reasons for declining the Netanyahu appearance.

claims.label: Host Says Egyptian Planes Turn Off Transponders on Roughly Ninety-Minute Trips Around Cairo

claims.transcript_snippet: They flew to P they flew from Cairo to Paris and Okay, random fact. Then it flew from Paris to St. Louis, Missouri. Stays for 5 days.
